heroHeadline: Cyclosporiasis Outbreak Keeps Slowing as Litigation Spreads to Illinois and Recall's True Reach Grows to 40 Jurisdictions
heroSubtitle: The multistate outbreak traced to Taylor Farms de México iceberg lettuce served at Taco Bell and sold under Walmart's Marketside brand remains at 10,930 people across 17 states (27,557 combined with other season-wide clusters) as of CDC's Aug 20 figures, with weekly case growth continuing to slow. A Chicago couple filed the first Illinois lawsuit against Taylor Farms on Aug 21, while food-safety watchdogs flagged that FDA quietly expanded its recalled-lettuce distribution list to 40 states and territories back on Aug 13 without individual notice to the newly added jurisdictions.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
